certificate.conditional_proof: alive=1 iff every signed positive date basket<H; no-overflow gives exact basket=floor(date stock sum/assets), hence each sum<=assets*H-1. The modular tree is then the ordinary integer sum. Original rounded total-average and discount coefficients bound the masked payoff. alive=0 returns exactly zero.
